final_joins: Part I’s Monell/Jett function-and-entity method and the authorized route are joined by all nine. Parts II–III’s County-attribution application and reverse/reinstate/remand are joined by Stone, Stevens, Souter, Ginsburg and Breyer. The four Associates do not adopt Stone’s additional practical-leverage, historical-accountability or Hess/Parker analogies as independent grounds. O'Connor, Scalia, Kennedy and Thomas join Part I but dissent from II–III; their common application respects the independent-office argument and reaches nonattribution through Alabama’s actual allocation, not a universal commission-control condition. No changed commitments or new join revision occurs. No Marks issue arises.
